savedReplies.title: Saved replies
savedReplies.descriptionBefore: Answers your team sends often. In the composer, type
savedReplies.descriptionAfter: followed by a shortcut, or pick one from the saved replies menu.
savedReplies.noMatchesHint: Try a title or a shortcut.
savedReplies.emptyHint: Save the answers you write most, then insert them with a slash.
savedReplies.bodyPlaceholder: Hi there, thanks for reaching out…
savedReplies.discardBody: Your changes to this reply will be lost.
savedReplies.deleteBody: will no longer be available in the composer.

emptyTips.slash: Type / and a shortcut in the composer
emptyTips.team: Replies are shared with your whole team

savedReplies.variablesHint: Variables are filled in for each ticket when the reply is inserted.

views.reorderAria: Reorder {{name}}. Hold Alt and press the arrow keys to move it.
views.title: Views
views.description: Saved filters in the sidebar under Views, with a live count. A view is yours alone, a team's or everyone's. Order here is the order in the sidebar.
views.emptyHint: A view is a saved filter, like urgent tickets for the billing team.

deleteFrom.me: will disappear from your sidebar. Tickets are not affected.
deleteFrom.team: will disappear from the sidebar of everyone on {{team}}. Tickets are not affected.
deleteFrom.anyTeam: will disappear from the sidebar of everyone on the team. Tickets are not affected.
deleteFrom.everyone: will disappear from the sidebar for everyone. Tickets are not affected.

audience.me: Only you see it in your sidebar.
audience.team: Everyone on {{team}} sees it in their sidebar.
audience.anyTeam: Everyone on the team sees it in their sidebar.
audience.everyone: Everyone in the workspace sees it in their sidebar.

views.discardBody: Your changes to this view will be lost.

emptyTips.sidebar: Shared views sit in everyone's sidebar
emptyTips.personal: Personal views stay in your sidebar only

sla.reorderAria: Reorder {{name}}. Hold Alt and press the arrow keys to move it.
sla.title: SLA policies
sla.description: Response and resolution targets. Policies are checked from top to bottom, and the first enabled one that matches a ticket's priority and team applies.
sla.emptyHint: Without a policy, tickets have no due times.
sla.footnote: Due times are shown on tickets and in the list. A breach notifies the assignee.
sla.deleteBodyAfter: keep their current due times. New tickets fall through to the next matching policy.
sla.dialogHint: Targets count every minute unless the policy counts business hours only.
sla.resolutionTooSoon: Resolution can't be sooner than the first response.
sla.badDuration: Enter each time as a number, from 1 minute to 365 days.

emptyTips.calendar: Policies can pause outside business hours

sla.businessHoursHint: The clock pauses outside business hours and on holidays.
sla.businessHoursOff: Business hours are off, so every minute counts until you turn them on.

automations.reorderAria: Reorder {{name}}. Hold Alt and press the arrow keys to move it.
automations.title: Automations
automations.description: Rules that run on their own when something happens to a ticket. They run in order, top to bottom.
automations.emptyHint: Route billing mail to the billing team, label urgent words, or close spam without lifting a finger.
automations.deleteBody: stops running. Tickets it already changed stay as they are.

emptyTips.order: Rules run in order, top to bottom
emptyTips.trigger: Each rule starts from a trigger, like a new ticket

edit.newHint: Choose when it runs, what has to match, and what it does.
edit.namePlaceholder: Route billing mail to the billing team
edit.noConditions: No conditions: the actions run every time.
edit.markSpamHint: Moves the ticket to Spam. No reply is sent.
edit.replyPlaceholder: Thanks for writing in. We've received your message…

problems.name: Name the automation.
problems.condition: Every condition needs a value, or remove it.

edit.replyVariablesHint: Sender variables, like the agent's name, are empty in automated replies.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: Your changes on this page will be lost.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.description: Decide who new tickets go to. Only teammates who are online and under their cap are picked.
assignment.defaultHint: Used for every ticket unless its team or mailbox has its own rule.

none.label: Off
none.hint: Tickets wait in Unassigned until someone takes them.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.hint: Teammates take turns, so the next ticket goes to the next person.

load_balanced.label: Load balanced
load_balanced.hint: The next ticket goes to whoever has the fewest open tickets.

rules.title: Rules
rules.hint: Give a team or a mailbox its own mode. A team rule wins over a mailbox rule.
rules.noTargets: Every team and mailbox has a rule
rules.emptyHint: Every ticket uses the default mode. Add a rule when one team or mailbox should share work differently, like load balancing billing.

tips.order: A ticket's team rule comes first, then its mailbox rule
tips.pool: Only members of that team are picked

assignment.notifyHint: Who hears when a ticket comes in and nobody is assigned to it. While Ollie answers a chat or an email itself, people hear when it hands over. Each person picks where it reaches them in their notification settings.

auto.label: Automatic
auto.hint: Everyone on small teams, only leads when more than 5 people would be notified.

everyone.label: Everyone on the team
everyone.hint: Everyone on the ticket's team, or everyone in the workspace when it has no team.

leads.label: Leads and admins only
leads.hint: The team's leads, or the owners and admins when it has no team or no lead.

off.label: Off
off.hint: Nobody is notified. New tickets wait in Unassigned.

assignment.awayHint: Teammates who step away stop getting new tickets until they are back.

away.label: Mark idle teammates away
away.off: Teammates stay online until they change it themselves

assignment.teamHint: Who can be assigned right now and how much each person has open. Viewers are never assigned.

teamEmpty.title: Nobody to assign yet
teamEmpty.description: Invite agents or admins so new tickets have someone to go to.

tips.viewers: Viewers can read tickets but are never assigned
tips.online: Only online teammates get new tickets

member.capHint: {{name}} stops getting new tickets at this many open and pending tickets.

triage.title: Triage
triage.description: {{name}} reads each new ticket and sorts it, so your team starts with the right priority and labels.

unavailable.title: AI is not set up
unavailable.body: {{name}} needs an AI provider before it can triage tickets.

explainer.title: How {{name}} triages
explainer.body: Every change {{name}} makes shows in the ticket timeline as made by {{name}}, so anyone can see why a ticket moved and change it back.

sample.subject: Charged twice for my annual plan
sample.label: Billing

auto.label: Triage new tickets
auto.hint: {{name}} looks at every new ticket as soon as it arrives.

fields.label: What {{name}} may change
fields.hint: Pick what triage is allowed to set on a ticket.

priority.label: Priority
priority.hint: Raise the priority when a ticket looks urgent. It never lowers it.

severity.label: Severity
severity.hint: Set Sev 1 to Sev 4 from the business impact. It only ever raises a severity.

labels.label: Labels
labels.hint: Add labels that match what the ticket is about.

team.label: Team
team.hint: Route a ticket with no team to the team that fits it best.

after.label: Assign after triage
after.hintMode: The ticket is then assigned with your {{mode}} mode.
after.hintNone: Assignment is off, so the ticket goes to whoever has the fewest open tickets.

engine.label: Engine
engine.jevHint: Fast, typed decisions with calibrated confidence. {{name}} applies a decision only when it is sure enough.
engine.llmHint: Your AI model answers the same questions, with no calibrated confidence. Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY to use the decision model instead.
engine.noneHint: Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY or an AI provider key to let {{name}} triage.

threshold.label: Confidence to apply
threshold.hint: At or above this, {{name}} applies a decision. Below it, the decision waits as a suggestion an agent accepts with one click.
threshold.llmNote: The LLM fallback has no calibrated confidence, so its decisions apply directly.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.description: When your team is open. SLA policies can count only these hours, so nights, weekends and holidays don't run the clock.
hours.enabledOn: SLA policies that count business hours pause outside these times
hours.enabledOff: Every minute counts toward SLA targets
hours.timezoneHint: Opening hours and holidays follow this time zone. It is also the workspace time zone.
hours.slaHint: Turn on business hours per policy.
hours.weekHint: Up to three ranges a day, on the quarter hour.
hours.maxRanges: Up to three ranges a day

errors.order: Each range has to end after it starts.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.hint: Closed all day. SLA clocks that count business hours stay paused.
holidays.name: Holiday name
holidays.duplicate: There is already a holiday on that date.
holidays.tooMany: You can add up to {{count}} holidays.
holidays.emptyHint: Add the days your team is closed, like public holidays, so SLA clocks don't run while nobody is around.

tips.closed: A holiday is closed for the whole day
tips.sla: Only policies that count business hours pause
